# bizar-dash — Obsidian Vault

Long-term memory for this project's AI agents.

## Structure

- `daily/` — daily journal entries (one file per day)
- `decisions/` — architecture / design decisions
- `patterns/` — code patterns learned
- `api/` — API contracts discovered
- `tasks/` — per-task learnings

All notes are plain markdown with YAML frontmatter.
Agents maintain this vault automatically.
